tickets.title: Start retirement plan rollover
tickets.text: Start preparing the Silver Marmot Laboratories 401(k) move after separation, including receiving account registration and processing the company-stock portion. Nadia Copperwisp's 401(k) has $914,000 with 38% in company stock, 52% in diversified equity funds, and 10% in stable value holdings.
